demo_where_non_literal_rejection.description: WHERE predicate with non-literal key (column reference) triggers E-QUERY-045(a). Predicate-position parity established by T-09a fix: filter_parser.rs fn_call_comparison maps 'json_extract_string' -> ScalarFunc::JsonExtractString (not Unknown), so the check_json_extract_key_literal gate fires.
